The script is ready at **`scripts/convert_and_email.py`**. Here's what you need to do before running it:

### 1. Install LibreOffice (if you haven't already)
| OS | Command |
|---|---|
| macOS | `brew install --cask libreoffice` |
| Ubuntu/Debian | `sudo apt install libreoffice` |
| Windows | [Download installer](https://www.libreoffice.org/download/) |

### 2. Update SMTP settings
Edit the configuration block near the top of the script:
- **`SMTP_HOST`** — your mail server (e.g. `smtp.gmail.com`)
- **`SMTP_PORT`** — typically `587` (STARTTLS) or `465` (SSL)
- **`SMTP_USER`** — your email address / login
- **`SMTP_PASSWORD`** — set it in the script or via an environment variable:
  ```bash
  export SMTP_PASSWORD="your-app-password"
  ```

### 3. Run it
```bash
python3 scripts/convert_and_email.py
```

The script will:
1. Convert `docs/customer_report.docx` → `docs/customer_report.pdf` using LibreOffice
2. Attach the PDF and email it to `bob@example.com`
